input.formula: every finite CNF with at least two labelled physical occurrences per clause, repetitions allowed; only appeared variables, each padded cycle length at least three
input.real_weights: arbitrary per-occurrence positive rational x,y with x+y<=1
input.dummy: x=1, no y/u eligibility; q and b remain original jobs; b pin/C both present
input.empty: one idle original machine, zero jobs, OPT0

strict.quantifiers: every original actual complete schedule of peak<=1 decodes SAT; every satisfying assignment yields one complete original strict schedule
strict.author_identity: E subset R and N-|E|+|R|<=N imply E=R
strict.independent_identity: 2N q/b jobs saturate 2N at-most-one q/b slots

upper.quantifiers: all SAT/UNSAT formulas, every legal occurrence-dependent weight table, ring order, dummy polarity: deterministically output one actual all-original-job schedule of peak<=3/2
upper.classification: baseline exists y<=1/2; active all y>1/2 imply all x<1/2
upper.graph_equivalence: remove/add forced baseline/dummy b_i-C_i pairs; preserve all q
upper.fractional_certificate: theta_i=1/k_c active else0; q half/half M with pin subtraction; b pin/C theta/1-theta; active u-C theta
upper.output: one common integer matching, map virtual query to same original C with original x, restore all baseline original u

counts.minimal_padding: N<=L+2v; extra explicit padding charged at actual N
counts.bit_complexity: explicit graph matching, rational comparisons and sums; no numeric inverse/denominator expansion

excluded_extensions: arbitrary new eligibility or external jobs
old physical D/h/R input as identical matrix
near2 hardness or general medium impossibility

other_primary.formal: only shared-outside 4–5; four-task standard matching no new research Claim; pool new exact-relation ID
other_primary.pool: all k>=2, positive rational a sum<=1, all S/T and all actual pool maps; patternOPT1 iff nonempty T subset S else2; actual C<2 itself has peak1
